author: high
claim: Let (G) be a finite connected undirected graph with at least one edge. Suppose every vertex of (G) has even degree. Prove that (G) has a closed trail that traverses every edge exactly once.

verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It selects a maximum-length trail, uses even-degree incidence parity to prove that the trail is closed, and then uses connectedness together with cyclic rotation and extension to prove that every edge is traversed. All hypotheses are used, the statement is self-contained, and there are no external references or prohibited justification patterns.
